text:
Valeri Nichushkin spent 404 games in Colorado, won a Stanley Cup there in 2022, and is 21 games into life with the Blue Jackets. It hasn't clicked at the net. He has 2 goals and 11 points, shooting 6.5%, and his own chances have dropped to 0.50 expected goals per 60 (the quality of his chances) from 1.07 last season.

Part of that is the company. Evolving-Hockey found he played with some of the strongest teammates in the league last season (99th percentile by their impact), and he still drove play at both ends once that was taken out: 2.1 wins above replacement, 47th among 401 forwards. In Columbus he's setting up more than shooting, with nine assists.

The minutes are growing, up about two a night over his last ten games to 18:20, so the role is there. What we'd watch is whether he gets back to the front of the net. Thirty-one shots in 21 games is the number that has to change before the goals do.
headline: Valeri Nichushkin is still looking for his shot in Columbus
